Package neqsim.process.controllerdevice

Class ModelPredictiveController.LinearMoveConstraint

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.controllerdevice.ModelPredictiveController.LinearMoveConstraint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ModelPredictiveController
public static final class ModelPredictiveController.LinearMoveConstraint extends Object implements Serializable
Linear bound on a weighted combination of multivariable control moves.

The constraint is evaluated as minDelta <= coefficients * (u - uPrevious) <= maxDelta. It can represent a shared actuator-movement budget by assigning equal coefficients to a group of controls, while zero coefficients exclude controls from the group.

      public LinearMoveConstraint(String name, double[] coefficients, double minDelta, double maxDelta)
      Construct a linear move constraint.
      Parameters:
      name - non-empty constraint name
      coefficients - control coefficients in configured control order; at least one must be non-zero
      minDelta - minimum permitted weighted move, or negative infinity for no lower bound
      maxDelta - maximum permitted weighted move, or positive infinity for no upper bound
